character.name: Widgetwraith the Many-Handed

traits.title: Stitched from TypeScript
traits.description: Its ectoplasm glows the exact blue of its main language.

traits.title: Rattles 42 chains
traits.description: One chain for every dependency it drags through the night.

traits.title: Still restless
traits.description: Pushed just days ago: this spirit refuses to stay buried.

character.originStory: SAMPLE DATA. Six winters ago, a tiny toolkit was laid to rest in an unmarked repo. Nobody expected it to stir. But each new dependency rattled the soil a little louder, until forty-two chains broke the surface and something pale and blue drifted out, clutching a lantern of half-finished widgets. Now Widgetwraith haunts the component libraries of the night, assembling buttons no one asked for and tooltips that whisper. Some say it pushed a commit only three days ago. Some say it never stopped. Either way, the lantern is still lit, and the widgets are still multiplying.
